meta.title: Let's Make a Kite!
meta.textType: functional: instructions in numbered steps, in a short frame

paragraphs: There is a lot of wind this afternoon. "Dad, can we make a kite?" asks Tom. "Yes!" says Dad. "We have got paper and a pencil." "We have got a ruler, crayons, and string." Tom and Dad sit at the table. Tom is very happy.

"One: Draw a long line with the ruler." "Two: Draw a short line." Now it is a cross. "Three: Draw the kite on the cross." "Four: Color the kite with your crayons." "Five: Put a long tail on the kite." "Six: Put the string on the kite." Look at the kite! It is big and red.

Tom and Dad go to the park. They stand next to the playground. "Run, Tom!" says Dad. The wind is good. "Look! Can it fly?" asks Tom. "Yes, it can!" says Dad. The kite flies and flies. Tom holds the string. Dad smiles at Tom. Tom is happy. His kite can fly!
text.summary: Tom and Dad make a kite in six steps. Then they fly it in the park.
